mapper.sql: (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_user u WHERE u.company_id = c.company_id AND u.del_yn = 'N')::int

WHERE c.del_yn = 'N' AND c.company_nm ILIKE '%' || #{s.companyNm} || '%' AND c.biz_reg_no LIKE '%' || #{s.bizRegNo} || '%' AND c.ceo_nm ILIKE '%' || #{s.ceoNm} || '%' AND c.status_cd = #{s.statusCd} AND c.reg_dt >= #{s.regDtFrom} AND c.reg_dt < #{s.regDtTo}::date + 1
mapper.select: SELECT c.company_id, c.company_nm, c.biz_reg_no, c.ceo_nm, c.biz_type, c.biz_item, c.tel_no, c.zip_cd, c.addr, c.addr_dtl, c.status_cd, cd.code_nm AS status_nm, AS member_cnt, ra.admin_nm AS reg_nm, c.reg_dt, ma.admin_nm AS mod_nm, c.mod_dt FROM tb_company c LEFT JOIN tb_code cd ON cd.group_cd = 'COMPANY_STATUS' AND cd.code = c.status_cd LEFT JOIN tb_admin ra ON ra.admin_id = c.reg_id LEFT JOIN tb_admin ma ON ma.admin_id = c.mod_id WHERE c.company_id = #{companyId} AND c.del_yn = 'N'
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_company WHERE biz_reg_no = #{bizRegNo})

INSERT INTO tb_company (company_nm, biz_reg_no, ceo_nm, biz_type, biz_item, tel_no, zip_cd, addr, addr_dtl, status_cd, reg_id, mod_id) VALUES (#{c.companyNm}, #{bizRegNo}, #{c.ceoNm}, #{c.bizType}, #{c.bizItem}, #{c.telNo}, #{c.zipCd}, #{c.addr}, #{c.addrDtl}, 'ACTIVE', #{regId}, #{regId}) RETURNING company_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_company SET company_nm = #{c.companyNm}, ceo_nm = #{c.ceoNm}, biz_type = #{c.bizType}, biz_item = #{c.bizItem}, tel_no = #{c.telNo}, zip_cd = #{c.zipCd}, addr = #{c.addr}, addr_dtl = #{c.addrDtl}, mod_id = #{modId}, mod_dt = now() WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND del_yn = 'N' AND date_trunc('second', mod_dt) = date_trunc('second', #{modDt}::timestamp)

UPDATE tb_company SET status_cd = #{statusCd}, mod_id = #{modId}, mod_dt = now() WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND del_yn = 'N' AND date_trunc('second', mod_dt) = date_trunc('second', #{modDt}::timestamp)
UPDATE tb_company SET del_yn = 'Y', mod_id = #{modId}, mod_dt = now() WHERE company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM tb_user WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND del_yn = 'N'

SELECT u.user_id, u.login_id, u.user_nm, u.dept_nm, u.position_nm, u.status_cd, cd.code_nm AS status_nm, u.join_dt FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_code cd ON cd.group_cd = 'USER_STATUS' AND cd.code = u.status_cd WHERE u.company_id = #{companyId} AND u.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY u.join_dt DESC, u.user_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
